name: pasted-text-becomes-a-sensible-goal-draft
description: Pasted notes about learning Rust become a draft with a title, a brief and a weekly schedule, and nothing exists until the form is confirmed.

goalDraft.paste: I want to get through the Rust book, one chapter a week, and I'd like a nudge every Monday at 9 with the next exercise.

text: {"title": "Learn Rust", "brief": "Work through the Rust book a chapter a week, with an exercise for each.", "schedule": {"cron": "0 9 * * 1", "prompt": "Pick the next chapter and set an exercise."}}
